title: Core: AS2 multiple assignment and chained assignment
description: Test compilation of: var x = y = z = 0 (chained assignment), a = b = c = someFunction(), x += y += 5 (compound chained). Also test augmented assignment operators: +=, -=, *=, /=, %=. Verify each emits the correct arithmetic opcode followed by ActionSetVariable or ActionSetMember. Test that chained assignment results in all variables receiving the same value.
